title: Angleton as OSS man in Italy

tellings.quote: made it clear to me that um James Jesus Angleton was the US like OSS person involved in Italy at the time.

plain: An American intelligence officer named James Jesus Angleton is said to have been the man of the OSS, America's wartime spy service before the CIA, in Italy during the 1940s. Michels says he learned this from a woman named Pippa Malmgren, who "made it clear" to him that Angleton was "the US like OSS person involved in Italy at the time." He raises it to tie Angleton to events in Italy in that period.
